image.description: OCI reference with an explicit TAG or digest. `latest` is refused: the artifact needs to say the same thing six months from now.

rationale.example: The module_map is all TypeScript over Node; the slim variant is enough and reduces surface.
rationale.description: Why THIS image. This is what makes the decision reviewable.

network.description: The container's network posture, decided ONCE in the artifact and not command by command. `egress` is cost and surface: the Architect asks, the user authorizes it at provisioning time.

pidsLimit.description: Process cap. This is what contains a fork bomb without depending on a verb allowlist.

400.description: Image with no explicit tag (or `latest`), `rationale` too short, `network` outside {none, egress}, or a resource above the cap.

403.description: Service token missing or different from the shared one.

404.description: Session, project, or resource not found.
